registration: Result-informed follow-up after v0.8. New models and independent phenotype contrasts specified before their results. Not external preregistration. Historical cohorts/outputs unchanged.

clinical.goal: Strengthen measured clinical comparability with previously audited infection-source, care-unit and co-medication information; do not claim treatment indication is adjudicated.
clinical.population_rule: Start from v0.8 physical ICU and physical ICU+recent nonscreen culture respectively. Within each population retain only exact baseline ICU units with at least one observed initiator in each drug arm. This baseline-only overlap-support restriction changes target population; no outcome or event count used.
clinical.model: Same v0.8 available-time corrected Firth overlap terms plus exact ICU-unit factor, nonscreen blood/urine cultures72h, known named organism7d, known enterococcus7d, observed creatinine AKI, available-time recorded UFH excluding explicit flush/lock labels, LMWH, selected other marrow-suppressive drugs7d, parenteral beta-lactam administration24h. Missing record flags are documentation proxies, not verified clinical absence.

beta_lactam.route: IV or INTRAVENOUS; actual administration event, no explicit zero without positive dose

clinical.source_availability: chart/start<t0, store<=t0. ICU input positive delivered amount, excluding Rewritten. eMAR recognized actual-administration event; route checked for beta-lactams. Do not use prescription order as administration. All prior medication covariates refreshed from strict pre-t0 sources.
clinical.weighting: brglmFit AS_mean, same numeric fallback frozen in v0.8; median fill within each sample. Remove constant/aliased columns deterministically. Report all variables, included balance, ESS and support restriction.
clinical.acceptance: Outcome-free model pass only if finite converged positive weights, maximum included |SMD|<=0.1 and valid resamples>=98%. Failed estimates remain diagnostics. No result-driven simpler model or subset search.
clinical.endpoints: Unchanged v0.7 hospital confirmed/single recovery and their death/discharge first-event probabilities; physical ICU confirmed/single as secondary observation-window sensitivities.
clinical.extra_feasibility: Separately count baseline-known platelet<100 first target-drug initiators without using discharge sepsis codes. No outcome comparisons or claim of validated expanded cohort until microbiology/location/source coverage audited.

external.primary_dataset: GSE65682:99 publicly thrombocytopenia-labeled admission samples in MARS whole-blood microarrays. Groups A<50, B50-99, C100-149, D150-399 per source study PMID26956172; verify unique sample identifier suffixes and no post-admission paired samples.
external.primary_contrast: A+B versus D (platelets<100 versus150-399), excluding C from primary. Expression model ~age+gender+pneumonia_source+thrombocytopenia. Age/gender/source adjusted if metadata complete; unknown explicit factor, not outcome-based sample deletion.
sensitivities: GSE65682 A+B+C versus D with same covariates
GSE65682 ordinal severity0(normal),1(C),2(B),3(A), same covariates; ordered-grade association, not continuous platelet dose-response
external.matrix: Use deposited RMA/quantile-normalized, ComBat-corrected matrix as supplied; do not log2 again or claim raw-array reprocessing. Exact GPL13667 symbol mapping; exclude ambiguous multiple-symbol probes and choose highest mean expression probe per symbol without group statistics.
external.second_dataset: GSE273700 Day1 only:22 thrombocytopenia vs30 non-thrombocytopenia labels, defined <=150 at ICU admission. Exact matrix-to-GSM-to-patient mapping. Day8 not recovery data without serial platelet values. Tissue metadata PBMC versus paper PAXgene whole blood remains unresolved; analyze as blood-derived phenotype support only, never platelet-specific validation.
external.second_methods: Retain nonnegative integer counts; TMM on supplied full counts, CPM>=1 in>=22 Day1 samples; limma-voom robust eBayes, group model and globin-logit-adjusted sensitivity. No imputation of unavailable clinical covariates or deletion of high-globin samples.
external.pathways: Same8 exact v0.8 Reactome sets. camera estimated correlation primary, fixed0.01 sensitivity, fry directional/mixed ancillary. BH across8 per contrast/test, untestable sets P=1 with minimum10 expressed genes. Report all branches; sensitivity significance cannot replace primary failure.
external.evidence: Matched thrombocytopenia phenotype across independent blood cohorts can strengthen disease context. It does not validate platelet-intrinsic activity, linezolid exposure effects or recovery dynamics. Original GSE252275 remains discovery; no changed discovery threshold or newly selected hub genes.
external.integrity: If identifier or statistical-unit audit fails, retain metadata failure and do not estimate that cohort. Processing batch/severity unavailable is stated, not assumed balanced.
